name: Blind Love
source:
When a man becomes the victim of a car crash that costs him his entire sense of sight, he has no choice but to try and live on without it. Treated with kid gloves by both his best friend and his sensitive girlfriend, he tries to make the best of his situation and becomes adjusted to using his remaining four senses while still being himself. However, can he keep and protect his love without being able to see her or her hardships?

[From [url=http://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/blind-love]itch.io[/url]]

Created for [url=http://itch.io/jam/ilujam]#iluJam[/url].
translation:
一個男人遭遇車禍，徹底失去了視力，只能想辦法在沒有視覺的情況下繼續生活。最好的朋友和體貼的女友都小心翼翼地對待他，他努力利用剩下的四種感官適應新生活，同時保持原本的自我。

然而，在無法看見女友、也看不見她所承受的痛苦時，他還能守護這段愛情嗎？
